decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC sit very close to the firm's core plate heat exchanger know-how, so it can readily interpret early feedback and refine the line.
The marine box cooler line builds on deep established water-cooling expertise and already claims a major market share, giving strong related knowledge and positive signals.
The marine cooling unit draws on the same marine cooling competence and service network, so the firm can assimilate customer learning and improve it through its own R&D.
The compact oil cooler line extends existing exchanger engineering to adjacent applications where the firm's manufacturing and service knowledge apply directly.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology that the firm understands well and can keep optimizing through in-house R&D and research cooperation.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build on the firm's heat-transfer R&D base and EU project experience, so their value can be developed further across the portfolio.
